7:17:2.noteEnglish: QAC tags لَـَٔاتِيَنَّهُم 2nd person masculine singular, but its prefix is hamza (أَ), the 1st person singular marker: Iblis says 'I will surely come to them'. Its mood stays as tagged: the fatha comes from the energetic nun of the oath answer (mabni), not from subjunctive nasb.
